annotations.title: Validate and format a phone number

description: Check whether a phone number is valid for its region and return its type (mobile, fixed line) and E.164, international and national formats, using Google libphonenumber for ~240 regions. Use it before saving a contact or sending SMS or WhatsApp. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /validate/phone via x402.

phone.description: Number in E.164 (e.g. +56912345678) or national format together with region.

region.description: ISO country code for national-format numbers, e.g. CL.
